objective: Find designs whose ligand-free OFF state is at least as tight as the reference protein's over four screening rounds, then rank unseen designs by the same class.

design_space.description: 20000 designs of the reference protein carrying 2 or 3 substitutions, drawn from one site-saturation library; every round orders from the same pool and each design may be screened at most once in the campaign. Sequences are in data/candidate_pool.csv; a design's substitutions are whatever differs from data/reference.fasta.

measurements.name: offstate_class
measurements.description: Ordered call on the ligand-free reporter level, lower level being a tighter OFF state: 0 above the reference protein's level by more than one assay standard deviation, so the switch has leaked; 1 above it but within that deviation; 2 at or below it; 3 at or below the best single substitution on record.

deliverable.description: UTF-8 JavaScript defining a deterministic, pointwise predict(sequence) over the 193-residue sequence that returns one finite number; larger means a tighter predicted OFF state, that is a higher predicted class.
